title: Housing construction subsidy
summary: Pays part of the cost of each new home so more new homes get built.

how: Town staff design the subsidy and propose its budget.
Residents comment at a public hearing on the budget.
Town Council votes on the budget that funds it.

evidence.source: Asquith, Mast & Reed (2023), Review of Economics and Statistics

evidence.claim: 1% more new supply lowers average rents ~0.19%
evidence.source: Mense (2025), Journal of Political Economy Macroeconomics

pros: Lowers the cost of each new home, so more building sites clear developers' profit hurdle.
cons: Paid from the Town budget, up to the yearly limit.
Much of the money goes to homes that would have been built anyway.
